summary.ru: (+) S + had + V3 · (–) S + had + not + V3 · (?) Had + S + V3?
summary.en: (+) S + had + V3 · (–) S + had + not + V3 · (?) Had + S + V3?

body.ru:
(+) **S + had + V3** — утверждение
(–) **S + had + not + V3**
(?) **Had + S + V3?**

• действие **раньше** другого прошлого
• результат уже был к прошлому моменту
• *by the time* + более позднее Past Simple
• *It was the first time* + опыт
• косвенная речь после *said, told, asked*
body.en:
• an action **earlier** than another past action
• a result already complete by a past moment
• *by the time* + a later Past Simple
• *It was the first time* + an experience
• reported speech after *said, told, asked*

examples: When we got home, the film had started.
By the time I called, she had left.
It was the first time he had flown.
By the end of May we had sold the house.
He told me that he had missed the train.
exampleTranslations: Когда мы пришли домой, фильм уже начался.
К тому времени, как я позвонил, она уже ушла.
К концу мая мы продали дом.
Он сказал мне, что опоздал на поезд.

body.ru:
• **by the time** (к тому времени)
• **when / before / after** (когда / до / после)
• **already / just** (уже / только что)
• **never / ever** (никогда / когда-либо)
• **yet** (ещё)
• **by Monday** (к понедельнику)
body.en:
• **by the time**

• **yet**
• **by Monday**

prompt.en: Match each situation with its example.

left.ru: когда мы пришли, концерт уже начался
left.en: when we arrived, the concert had already begun

pairs.right: When we arrived, the concert had already begun.

left.ru: к тому времени, как ты позвонил, я ушёл из офиса
left.en: by the time you called, I had left the office

pairs.right: By the time you called, I had left the office.

left.ru: она собрала вещи до приезда такси
left.en: she had packed her bags before the taxi arrived

pairs.right: She had packed her bags before the taxi arrived.

left.ru: после работы он пошёл в спортзал
left.en: after work he went to the gym

pairs.right: After he had finished work, he went to the gym.

explanation.ru: When, by the time, before и after показывают порядок событий: более раннее действие — в Past Perfect.
explanation.en: When, by the time, before and after show the order of events: the earlier action is in the past perfect.

prompt.en: Match each situation with its example.

left.en: I had seen that film before

pairs.right: I had seen that film before.

left.ru: к приходу родителей ребёнок уже разбил окно
left.en: the child had broken the window before his parents got home

pairs.right: The child had broken the window by the time his parents got home.

left.ru: он написал отчёт к пятнице
left.en: he had written the report by Friday

pairs.right: He had written the report by Friday.

left.ru: кто-то взял мой зонт по ошибке
left.en: someone had taken my umbrella by mistake

pairs.right: Someone had taken my umbrella by mistake.

explanation.ru: После had стоит третья форма глагола: seen, broken, written, taken.
explanation.en: After had comes the third form of the verb: seen, broken, written, taken.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

left.ru: полное отрицание
left.en: a full negative

pairs.right: They had not finished the work.

left.ru: отрицание с никогда
left.en: a negative with never

pairs.right: I had never visited that museum.

left.ru: вопрос-отрицание
left.en: a negative question

pairs.right: Had you not seen the sign?

left.ru: отрицание до того вечера
left.en: a negative before that evening

pairs.right: She had not met him before that evening.

explanation.ru: Отрицание Past Perfect: had not + V3; never и before часто сопровождают его.
explanation.en: The past perfect negative is had not + V3; never and before often go with it.

prompt.en: Match each situation with its example.

left.ru: вопрос о том, когда она ушла из офиса
left.en: asking when she had left the office

pairs.right: When had she left the office?

left.ru: вопрос о причине отмены поездки
left.en: asking why they had cancelled the trip

pairs.right: Why had they cancelled the trip?

left.ru: вопрос о том, как долго он работал до пенсии
left.en: asking how long he had worked before he retired

pairs.right: How long had he worked there before he retired?

left.ru: общий вопрос: ты прочитал книгу до урока?
left.en: a yes/no question: had you read the book before the lesson

pairs.right: Had you read the book before the lesson?

explanation.ru: В вопросах Past Perfect had стоит первым, вопросительное слово — перед had.
explanation.en: In past perfect questions had comes first, and a question word comes before had.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

left.ru: она ушла до того, как я пришёл
left.en: she had left before I arrived

pairs.right: She had left before I arrived.

left.ru: конкретное законченное прошлое
left.en: a specific finished past

pairs.right: She left at seven o'clock.

left.ru: она только что вышла из офиса — результат сейчас
left.en: she has just left the office — a result now

pairs.right: She has just left the office.

left.ru: процесс в тот момент
left.en: a process at that moment

pairs.right: She was leaving when I called.

explanation.ru: Past Perfect — раньше другого прошлого, Past Simple — конкретное прошлое, Present Perfect — результат сейчас, Past Continuous — процесс тогда.
explanation.en: The past perfect is earlier than another past action, the past simple a specific past, the present perfect a result now, and the past continuous a process then.
